mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5pp in 3 months) signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%), a combination of falling unemployment and strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k) signals an overheating labor market that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5 and PAYEMS growth > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, rising housing starts (HOUST > 2000) indicate peak economic activity that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST > 2000.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in all economic regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the core CPI (CPIAUCSL rising > 0.2pp in 3 months) signals accelerating inflation, which may lead the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 4.5%) over the past 6 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE falling > 0.3pp in 3 months) signals a tightening labor market that may lead to wage inflation and Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 3 months.
